en.B: For the music director. A psalm of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur. Psaume de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Un psaume de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Zaburi ya Daudi.

sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Wimbo wa Daudi.

es.B: Al director del coro. Salmo de David.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Canto de David.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]. [Một] thi thiên của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Thi thiên của Đa-vít.

ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해 다윗이 지은 노래.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: the last group of David's psalms
decisions.reason: Psalms 138-145 are the last group of psalms headed "of David". Psalms 140-143 are all prayers for rescue from enemies who lay traps, plot and slander.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: "Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]" (L), "Cho nhạc trưởng" (B), "Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc" (R); "thi thiên" (L, B), "bài ca" (R)
decisions.reason: The director line and the word for a psalm follow the published Psalms 23 and 139; Literal brackets what the director led, as there.

decisions.choice: "지휘자를 위하여" (L), "음악 지휘자를 위하여" (B), "찬양 인도자를 위해" (R); "다윗의 시" (L, B), "다윗이 지은 노래" (R), as the published Psalm 139:1
decisions.reason: The terms note follows the published Psalm 139:1 for the director line and the style guide for "a psalm of David"; the older "영장" is not current Korean.

source.text: חַלְּצֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה מֵאָדָ֣ם רָ֑ע מֵאִ֖ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Rescue me, YHWH, from humankind evil; from [the] man of violences preserve me,

en.L: Rescue me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, from evil humankind; from {{gender:the person|the man}} of violence preserve me,
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, rescue me from evil people; keep me safe from those who do violence,
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, save me from evil people. Protect me from people who hurt others.

fr.L: Délivre-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, de l’humain mauvais ; de {{gender:l’être|l’homme}} de violence préserve-moi,
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, délivre-moi des gens mauvais ; garde-moi de ceux qui font violence,
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sauve-moi des gens mauvais. Protège-moi des gens qui font du mal aux autres.

sw.L: Uniokoe, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na wanadamu waovu; na mtu wa jeuri unihifadhi,
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uniokoe na watu waovu; unilinde salama na wale wanaotenda jeuri,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, niokoe na watu waovu. Unilinde na watu wanaowaumiza wengine.

es.L: Líbrame, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, del ser humano malvado; {{gender:de la persona|del hombre}} de violencias guárdame,
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, líbrame de la gente malvada; protégeme de los que cometen violencia,
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sálvame de la gente malvada. Protégeme de la gente que hace daño a los demás.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giải cứu tôi khỏi loài người gian ác; xin gìn giữ tôi khỏi kẻ hung bạo,
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giải cứu tôi khỏi những kẻ gian ác; xin giữ tôi an toàn khỏi những kẻ làm điều hung bạo,
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cứu tôi khỏi những kẻ gian ác. Xin bảo vệ tôi khỏi những kẻ làm hại người khác.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 악한 사람에게서 저를 건져 주십시오. 폭력의 사람에게서 저를 지켜 주십시오,
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 악한 사람들에게서 저를 건져 주시고, 폭력을 일삼는 자들에게서 저를 지켜 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 악한 사람들에게서 저를 구해 주십시오. 남을 해치는 사람들에게서 저를 보호해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: the man of violence: a kind of person, many people
decisions.reason: Both phrases are singular in the Hebrew ("evil humankind", "the man of violences"), but verse 3 goes on with "they": the singular stands for everyone of that kind.

decisions.choice: violence: harm done to others, lawless cruelty
decisions.reason: The word (chamas) is violence and injustice done to people, the sin that filled the earth before the flood (Genesis 6:11). The plural here makes it stronger: a person made of violence.

decisions.choice: evil people; those who do violence
alternatives: the evil man; the violent man
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the singular stands for (m1), a whole group, which includes men and women alike; Literal keeps the singular with a gender setting.

decisions.choice: "l'être" by default, "l'homme" as the gender alternative, for "the man of violence" (here and in verses 5 and 12)
decisions.reason: The phrase means a kind of person, as the meaning decision says. French puts the setting on the noun; "être" is masculine like "homme", so the pronouns that refer back to it in verse 12 ("il", "le") read correctly with either option.

decisions.choice: "kẻ hung bạo" (L) with no gender span; the same through Psalms 140-141
alternatives: a gender span as in the English ("the person"/"the man")
decisions.reason: "kẻ" already covers men and women, so Vietnamese has no second form for the setting to give, as in Psalm 139:19.

decisions.choice: "사람" with no gender span (verses 2, 5, 12)
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" is the ordinary word for a person of either sex, so it has no second wording for the English "the person|the man" span; the prayer is in 합쇼체 with 저, as through these psalms.

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשְׁב֣וּ רָע֣וֹת בְּלֵ֑ב כָּל־י֝֗וֹם יָג֥וּרוּ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: who plan evil things in [the] heart; every day they stir up wars.

en.L: who plan evil things in [the] heart; every day they stir up wars.
en.B: who scheme harm in their hearts and keep starting battles day after day.
en.R: They make evil plans in their minds. Every day they start fights.

fr.L: qui méditent des choses mauvaises dans [leur] cœur ; chaque jour ils suscitent des guerres.
fr.B: qui trament le mal dans leur cœur et provoquent des combats jour après jour.
fr.R: Ils font des projets mauvais dans leur tête. Chaque jour ils déclenchent des disputes.

sw.L: ambao hupanga mabaya moyoni; kila siku huchochea vita.
sw.B: wanaopanga madhara mioyoni mwao na kuanzisha mapigano siku baada ya siku.
sw.R: Wanapanga mipango mibaya akilini mwao. Kila siku wanaanzisha ugomvi.

es.L: que traman maldades en [el] corazón; cada día provocan guerras.
es.B: que traman el mal en su corazón y día tras día empiezan peleas.
es.R: Hacen planes malvados en su mente. Todos los días empiezan peleas.

vi.L: là những kẻ mưu tính điều ác trong lòng; mỗi ngày chúng khơi lên chiến tranh.
vi.B: là những kẻ âm mưu điều ác trong lòng, và ngày này qua ngày khác cứ gây ra chiến tranh.
vi.R: Chúng bày ra những mưu ác trong đầu. Ngày nào chúng cũng gây chuyện đánh nhau.

ko.L: 그들은 마음속으로 악한 일들을 꾸미고, 날마다 싸움을 일으킵니다.
ko.B: 그들은 마음속으로 해칠 일을 꾸미며, 날마다 싸움을 일으킵니다.
ko.R: 그들은 속으로 악한 계획을 세웁니다. 날마다 싸움을 일으킵니다.

decisions.choice: stir up: provoke, start
decisions.reason: The verb (gur) can mean to stir up strife, or to gather as a band and attack (56:7; 59:4). Either way the enemies are always looking for a fight.

decisions.choice: in the heart: in the mind, in secret
decisions.reason: The heart is where people think and plan. Their evil is plotted before it is done.

decisions.choice: in their minds
decisions.reason: Readable says where the planning happens in plain words (m2).

source.text: שָֽׁנֲנ֣וּ לְשׁוֹנָם֮ כְּֽמוֹ־נָ֫חָ֥שׁ חֲמַ֥ת עַכְשׁ֑וּב תַּ֖חַת שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: They sharpen their tongue like a snake; venom of a viper [is] under their lips. Selah.

en.L: They sharpen their tongue like a snake; [the] venom of a viper [is] under their lips. Selah
en.B: They whet their tongues like a serpent; viper's venom lies hidden behind their lips. Selah
en.R: Their words are as dangerous as a snake's bite. What they say is like deadly poison. Selah

fr.L: Ils aiguisent leur langue comme un serpent ; [le] venin de la vipère [est] sous leurs lèvres. Sélah
fr.B: Ils affûtent leur langue comme un serpent ; un venin de vipère se cache derrière leurs lèvres. Sélah
fr.R: Leurs paroles sont aussi dangereuses qu’une morsure de serpent. Ce qu’ils disent est comme un poison mortel. Sélah

sw.L: Wanaunoa ulimi wao kama nyoka; sumu ya kifutu [iko] chini ya midomo yao. Sela
sw.B: Wanazinoa ndimi zao kama nyoka; sumu ya kifutu imejificha nyuma ya midomo yao. Sela
sw.R: Maneno yao ni hatari kama kuumwa na nyoka. Wanayoyasema ni kama sumu inayoua. Sela

es.L: Afilan su lengua como una serpiente; veneno de víbora [hay] debajo de sus labios. Selah
es.B: Aguzan su lengua como una serpiente; veneno de víbora se esconde tras sus labios. Selah
es.R: Sus palabras son tan peligrosas como la mordida de una serpiente. Lo que dicen es como un veneno mortal. Selah

vi.L: Chúng mài lưỡi mình như con rắn; nọc độc của rắn lục [ở] dưới môi chúng. Sê-la
vi.B: Chúng mài lưỡi mình sắc như rắn; nọc độc rắn lục ẩn sau môi chúng. Sê-la
vi.R: Lời chúng nói nguy hiểm như rắn cắn. Những gì chúng nói như nọc độc chết người. Sê-la

ko.L: 그들은 뱀처럼 자기 혀를 날카롭게 하니, 독사의 독이 그들의 입술 아래에 있습니다. 셀라
ko.B: 그들은 뱀처럼 혀를 날카롭게 갈고, 그들의 입술 뒤에는 독사의 독이 숨어 있습니다. 셀라
ko.R: 그들의 말은 뱀에게 물리는 것만큼 위험합니다. 그들이 하는 말은 무서운 독과 같습니다. 셀라

decisions.choice: quoted in Romans 3:13
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the second line, from the ancient Greek translation ("the poison of asps is under their lips"), with 5:10 and other psalms, to show that all people are under sin (Romans 3:9-18).

decisions.choice: viper: a poisonous snake
decisions.reason: The word ('akhshuv) is found only here. The ancient Greek translation has "asp"; it is some poisonous creature, most likely a snake.

decisions.choice: sharpen their tongue: make their words wound
decisions.reason: Words are pictured as weapons that cut and poison (52:4; 64:4). A snake's tongue was thought of as the source of its venom.

decisions.choice: their words are as dangerous as a snake's bite
alternatives: they sharpen their tongues like a snake
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m3): the danger is in what they say.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Sélah", kept at the end of the verse at every level
decisions.reason: Selah is a word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a direction for the music or the singers. As the terms note sets, French keeps the word in its French spelling where the Hebrew has it.

decisions.choice: "Sela" kept at the end of the verse at every level, through Psalms 140-150
decisions.reason: Selah is a Hebrew word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a direction for the music or the singers. Swahili keeps it in its Swahili spelling, as the English keeps it, rather than guess at a translation.

decisions.choice: "kifutu" (puff adder) for the viper
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names a viper; "kifutu", the puff adder, is the best-known viper in East Africa.

decisions.choice: Selah
decisions.reason: Selah is a Hebrew word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a direction for the music or the singers. Spanish keeps it as it is, at the end of the verse, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Sê-la" kept at the end of the verse, as a word
decisions.reason: No one now knows what Selah means; it is probably a direction for the music (see the meaning decision). Vietnamese keeps the word, in the form Bible readers know, where the Hebrew has it.

decisions.choice: "셀라" kept at the end of the verse at every level (verses 4, 6, 9)
decisions.reason: The word's meaning is no longer known; it is probably a musical direction (meaning decision). The terms note keeps it as a name, "셀라", where the English has it.

source.text: שָׁמְרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה׀מִ֘ידֵ֤י רָשָׁ֗ע מֵאִ֣ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵ֑נִי אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָ֝שְׁב֗וּ לִדְח֥וֹת פְּעָמָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Keep me, YHWH, from [the] hands of [the] wicked; from [the] man of violences preserve me, who have planned to push down my steps.

en.L: Keep me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, from [the] hands of [the] wicked; from {{gender:the person|the man}} of violence preserve me, [those] who have planned to trip up my steps.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, guard me from the clutches of the wicked; shield me from violent people who are scheming to make me fall.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, keep me out of the hands of evil people. Protect me from violent people. They are planning to make me fall.

fr.L: Garde-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, des mains du méchant ; de {{gender:l’être|l’homme}} de violence préserve-moi, [ceux] qui ont projeté de faire trébucher mes pas.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, garde-moi des griffes des méchants ; protège-moi des gens violents qui complotent pour me faire tomber.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, garde-moi loin des mains des méchants. Protège-moi des gens violents. Ils préparent un plan pour me faire tomber.

sw.L: Unilinde, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na mikono ya mwovu; na mtu wa jeuri unihifadhi, [wale] ambao wamepanga kuzikwaza hatua zangu.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unilinde na makucha ya waovu; unikinge na watu wa jeuri wanaopanga njama ya kuniangusha.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uniepushe na mikono ya watu waovu. Unilinde na watu wa jeuri. Wanapanga kuniangusha.

es.L: Guárdame, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, de [las] manos [del] malvado; {{gender:de la persona|del hombre}} de violencias protégeme, [los] que han planeado hacer tropezar mis pasos.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, guárdame de las garras de los malvados; protégeme de la gente violenta que trama hacerme caer.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no me dejes caer en manos de la gente malvada. Protégeme de la gente violenta. Están planeando hacerme caer.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin gìn giữ tôi khỏi tay kẻ ác; xin bảo vệ tôi khỏi kẻ hung bạo, [là những kẻ] đã mưu tính làm cho bước chân tôi vấp ngã.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin canh giữ tôi khỏi nanh vuốt kẻ ác; xin che chở tôi khỏi những kẻ hung bạo đang âm mưu làm cho tôi ngã.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giữ tôi khỏi rơi vào tay những kẻ gian ác. Xin bảo vệ tôi khỏi những kẻ hung bạo. Chúng đang tính kế để làm cho tôi ngã.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 악인의 손에서 저를 지키시고, 폭력의 사람에게서 저를 보호해 주십시오. 그들은 제 걸음을 넘어뜨리려고 꾀하였습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 악인들의 손아귀에서 저를 지켜 주시고, 저를 넘어뜨리려고 꾀하는 난폭한 자들에게서 저를 보호해 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 악한 사람들의 손에 잡히지 않게 저를 지켜 주십시오. 난폭한 사람들에게서 저를 보호해 주십시오. 그들은 저를 넘어뜨리려고 계획하고 있습니다.

decisions.choice: the hands of the wicked: their power
decisions.reason: To be in someone's hands is to be in their power.

decisions.choice: the man of violence ... who have planned
decisions.reason: As in verse 2, the singular stands for a group: the verb after it is plural.

decisions.choice: push down my steps: make me stumble and fall
decisions.reason: The picture is of walking on a path and being tripped, as the traps of verse 6 go on to show.

decisions.choice: violent people
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: "악인" (L, B), "악한 사람" (R) for the wicked
decisions.reason: As the terms note for Psalms and Proverbs.

source.text: טָֽמְנֽוּ־גֵאִ֨ים׀פַּ֡ח לִ֗י וַחֲבָלִ֗ים פָּ֣רְשׂוּ רֶ֭שֶׁת לְיַד־מַעְגָּ֑ל מֹקְשִׁ֖ים שָֽׁתוּ־לִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: They have hidden, [the] proud, a trap for me and cords; they have spread a net at [the] side of [the] track; snares they have set for me. Selah.

en.L: [The] proud have hidden a trap for me, and cords; they have spread a net by [the] side of [the] path; snares they have set for me. Selah
en.B: Arrogant people have hidden a trap for me; they have stretched out ropes as a net beside the path and laid snares to catch me. Selah
en.R: Proud people have hidden a trap to catch me. They have spread out a net of ropes beside the road. They have set traps for me. Selah

fr.L: [Les] orgueilleux ont caché pour moi un piège et des cordes ; ils ont tendu un filet au bord du sentier ; des pièges, ils en ont posé pour moi. Sélah
fr.B: Des arrogants ont caché un piège pour moi ; ils ont tendu des cordes comme un filet au bord du chemin et posé des pièges pour me prendre. Sélah
fr.R: Des orgueilleux ont caché un piège pour m’attraper. Ils ont étendu un filet de cordes au bord de la route. Ils ont posé des pièges pour moi. Sélah

sw.L: Wenye kiburi wamenifichia mtego, na kamba; wametandaza wavu kando ya njia; wameniwekea mitego. Sela
sw.B: Watu wenye majivuno wamenifichia mtego; wametandaza kamba kama wavu kando ya njia na kunitegea mitego ya kunikamata. Sela
sw.R: Watu wenye kiburi wameficha mtego ili kunikamata. Wametandaza wavu wa kamba kando ya barabara. Wameniwekea mitego. Sela

es.L: [Los] soberbios me han escondido una trampa, y cuerdas; han tendido una red junto al camino; me han puesto lazos. Selah
es.B: Los arrogantes me han escondido una trampa; han tendido cuerdas como red junto al camino y me han puesto lazos para atraparme. Selah
es.R: La gente orgullosa ha escondido una trampa para atraparme. Han tendido una red de cuerdas junto al camino. Me han puesto trampas. Selah

vi.L: [Những kẻ] kiêu ngạo đã giấu bẫy cho tôi, và dây thừng; chúng đã giăng lưới bên [lề] đường; chúng đã đặt các bẫy dò cho tôi. Sê-la
vi.B: Những kẻ kiêu căng đã giấu bẫy để hại tôi; chúng giăng dây làm lưới bên lối đi, và đặt bẫy dò để bắt tôi. Sê-la
vi.R: Những kẻ kiêu ngạo đã giấu bẫy để bắt tôi. Chúng giăng lưới bằng dây thừng bên đường. Chúng đã đặt bẫy để hại tôi. Sê-la

ko.L: 교만한 자들이 저를 잡으려고 덫과 줄들을 숨겼고, 길 옆에 그물을 펼쳤으며, 저를 잡으려고 올무들을 놓았습니다. 셀라
ko.B: 거만한 자들이 저를 잡으려고 덫을 숨겼습니다. 그들은 길가에 줄을 그물처럼 펼쳐 놓고, 저를 잡으려고 올가미를 놓았습니다. 셀라
ko.R: 교만한 사람들이 저를 잡으려고 덫을 숨겼습니다. 길가에 밧줄로 된 그물을 펼쳐 놓았습니다. 저를 잡으려고 덫을 놓았습니다. 셀라

decisions.choice: trap, net, snares: the hunter's tools
decisions.reason: Birds and animals were caught with hidden traps, nets of cord and snares (91:3; 124:7). The enemies hunt the psalmist like prey, setting traps along the path he walks (142:4).

decisions.choice: cords ... a net: they spread cords as a net
alternatives: a trap and cords they have hidden; they have spread a net
decisions.reason: "Cords" can belong with the trap that was hidden, or with the net that was spread (a net made of cords). The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the proud: the arrogant, who do not fear God
decisions.reason: The proud (ge'im) are those who think they need answer to no one (94:2).

source.text: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭יהוָה אֵ֣לִי אָ֑תָּה הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I have said to YHWH, My God [are] you; give ear, YHWH, [to the] voice of my supplications.

en.L: I have said to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "My God [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}." Give ear, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, to the voice of my pleas for mercy.
en.B: I have told {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "You are my God." Turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, to the sound of my pleading.
en.R: I said to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "You are my God." {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, please listen when I beg {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for help.

fr.L: J’ai dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Mon Dieu, [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. » Prête l’oreille, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à la voix de mes supplications.
fr.B: J’ai dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Tu es mon Dieu. » Tends l’oreille, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, au son de mes supplications.
fr.R: J’ai dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Tu es mon Dieu. » {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute-moi quand je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} supplie de m’aider.

sw.L: Nimemwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Mungu wangu [ni] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}." Usikilize, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sauti ya maombi yangu ya rehema.
sw.B: Nimemwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Wewe ni Mungu wangu." Utege sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usikie sauti ya kusihi kwangu.
sw.R: Nilimwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Wewe ni Mungu wangu." {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tafadhali usikilize ninapokuomba msaada.

es.L: He dicho {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Mi Dios [eres] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}». Escucha, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, la voz de mis súplicas.
es.B: Le he dicho {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Tú eres mi Dios». Inclina {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} oído, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, a la voz de mis ruegos.
es.R: Le dije {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Tú eres mi Dios». {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por favor, escúchame cuando {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ruego que me ayudes.

vi.L: Tôi đã thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ngài [là] Đức Chúa Trời của tôi." Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin lắng tai nghe tiếng tôi nài xin thương xót.
vi.B: Tôi đã thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi." Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghiêng tai nghe tiếng tôi khẩn nài.
vi.R: Tôi đã thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi." Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin lắng nghe khi tôi nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp đỡ.

ko.L: 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 "주님은 저의 하나님이십니다" 하고 말하였습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 자비를 구하는 제 간구의 소리에 귀를 기울여 주십시오.
ko.B: 저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 "주님은 저의 하나님이십니다" 하고 아뢰었습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 애원하는 제 소리에 귀를 기울여 주십시오.
ko.R: 저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 "주님은 저의 하나님이십니다" 하고 말씀드렸습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 도와 달라고 애원할 때 들어 주십시오.

decisions.choice: supplications: pleas for mercy
decisions.reason: The word (tachanunim) comes from the verb "to show favor": it is a plea to be treated with mercy (28:2; 130:2).

decisions.choice: give ear: listen closely
decisions.reason: To give ear is to turn and listen (5:2; 17:1).

decisions.choice: My God are you: a confession of trust
decisions.reason: The psalmist claims the LORD as his own God, as in 31:15. His plea rests on that bond.

source.text: יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי עֹ֣ז יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י סַכֹּ֥תָה לְ֝רֹאשִׁ֗י בְּי֣וֹם נָֽשֶׁק׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH [the] Lord, strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in [the] day of weapons.

en.L: {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} my Lord, strength of my salvation, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have covered my head in [the] day of weapons.
en.B: Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, mighty one who saves me, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have covered my head on the day the weapons clash.
en.R: Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are strong and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save me. You protected my head like a helmet when I was in battle.

fr.L: {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} mon Seigneur, force de mon salut, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as couvert ma tête au jour des armes.
fr.B: Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} le puissant qui me sauves, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as couvert ma tête le jour où les armes s’entrechoquent.
fr.R: Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fort et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me sauves. Tu as protégé ma tête comme un casque quand j’étais dans la bataille.

sw.L: {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} Bwana wangu, nguvu ya wokovu wangu, umekifunika kichwa changu katika siku ya silaha.
sw.B: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, mwenye nguvu unayeniokoa, umekifunika kichwa changu siku silaha zinapogongana.
sw.R: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} una nguvu na unaniokoa. Ulikilinda kichwa changu kama kofia ya chuma nilipokuwa vitani.

es.L: {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, mi Señor, fuerza de mi salvación, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has cubierto mi cabeza en [el] día de las armas.
es.B: Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, poderoso salvador mío, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has cubierto mi cabeza el día en que chocan las armas.
es.R: Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres fuerte y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me salvas. Me protegiste la cabeza como un casco cuando estaba en la batalla.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Chúa của tôi, sức mạnh của sự cứu rỗi tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã che chở đầu tôi trong ngày binh khí.
vi.B: Lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng quyền năng giải cứu tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã che chở đầu tôi trong ngày giáo gươm giao chiến.
vi.R: Lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mạnh mẽ và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu tôi. Ngài đã che chở đầu tôi như mũ sắt khi tôi ra trận.

ko.L: {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 제 주님, 제 구원의 힘이시여, 무기들의 날에 주님께서 제 머리를 덮어 주셨습니다.
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}여, 저를 구원하시는 강한 분이시여, 무기가 부딪치는 날에 주님께서 제 머리를 가려 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}여, 주님은 강하시고 저를 구원하십니다. 제가 싸움터에 있을 때 주님께서 투구처럼 제 머리를 지켜 주셨습니다.

decisions.choice: GOD my Lord: the divine name and the title
decisions.reason: Here the name comes before the title "my Lord" ('Adonai), as in 68:21 and 109:21. The name is then read aloud as "God" so as not to say "Lord" twice.

decisions.choice: strength of my salvation: the strong one who saves me
decisions.reason: The phrase names God as the power behind the psalmist's rescue (28:8).

decisions.choice: covered my head: protected me in battle
decisions.reason: God has been like a helmet to him (60:9 calls Ephraim "the helmet of my head"). "The day of weapons" is a day of battle.

decisions.choice: GOD my Lord (L); Lord GOD (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 68:21: the name is written GOD so that the two are not read as "Lord Lord"; Balanced and Readable use the familiar order, with "Lord" in address.

decisions.choice: protected my head like a helmet
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the picture (m3).

decisions.choice: "DIEU mon Seigneur" (Literal), "Seigneur DIEU" (Balanced, Readable), with "Yahvé" under the divine-name setting
decisions.reason: Where the divine name stands beside ʾAdonai, the French terms write it "DIEU" in capitals, as the English writes "GOD", so that "Seigneur" is not said twice. Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: "MUNGU Bwana wangu" (L) and "Bwana MUNGU" (B, R) for Adonai with the divine name, with "Yahwe" as the alternative for MUNGU
decisions.reason: Where the name stands beside the title Adonai (Lord), Swahili writes the name as "MUNGU" in capitals, as the English writes "GOD", so that "Bwana BWANA" is not read twice; the name setting shows "Yahwe".

decisions.choice: "DIOS, mi Señor" (L); "Señor DIOS" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here the name YHWH stands beside the title Adonai. As the English does, Spanish writes the name as "DIOS" in capitals (with "Yahvé" as the setting's alternative) so as not to say "Señor" twice.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA, Chúa của tôi" (L); "Chúa là CHÚA" (B, R) for the divine name joined to the title Lord
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the divine name to the title "my Lord" (see the meaning decision). Two words "Chúa" side by side would read as a slip, so Literal keeps the Hebrew order with "Chúa của tôi" after the name, and Balanced and Readable say "the Lord who is the LORD", as the English says "Lord GOD". The capitals of the name, with "Gia-vê" behind the setting, keep the two apart.

decisions.choice: The name with Adonai is {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}: "{{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 제 주님" (L, in the Hebrew order), "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}" (B, R)
alternatives: the usual span (주 or 야훼) followed by 제 주님
decisions.reason: Where the name stands with Adonai ("Lord"), the English reads "GOD" so as not to say "Lord LORD"; Korean does the same with 하나님 as the default, so the title 주 and the name are not doubled. This follows the Psalms-wide choice for Adonai YHWH.

source.text: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֭הוָה מַאֲוַיֵּ֣י רָשָׁ֑ע זְמָמ֥וֹ אַל־תָּ֝פֵ֗ק יָר֥וּמוּ סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not grant, YHWH, [the] desires of [the] wicked; his plan do not further; they would be exalted. Selah.

en.L: Do not grant, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the desires of the wicked; do not further his scheme, [or] they will be exalted. Selah
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not give the wicked what they crave; do not let their scheme succeed, or they will grow proud. Selah
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not let evil people get what they want. Do not let their plans work, or they will become proud. Selah

fr.L: N’accorde pas, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, les désirs du méchant ; ne favorise pas son projet, [sinon] ils s’élèveront. Sélah
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne donne pas aux méchants ce qu’ils convoitent ; ne laisse pas réussir leur projet, sinon ils deviendront orgueilleux. Sélah
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne laisse pas les méchants obtenir ce qu’ils veulent. Ne laisse pas leurs plans réussir, sinon ils vont devenir orgueilleux. Sélah

sw.L: Usiyatimize, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, matakwa ya mwovu; usiifanikishe hila yake, [la sivyo] watajiinua. Sela
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usiwape waovu wanachokitamani; usiache hila yao ifanikiwe, la sivyo watajivuna. Sela
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usiwaache watu waovu wapate wanachotaka. Usiache mipango yao ifanikiwe, la sivyo watakuwa na kiburi. Sela

es.L: No concedas, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, los deseos del malvado; no favorezcas su plan, [o] se enaltecerán. Selah
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no les des a los malvados lo que desean; no dejes que su plan tenga éxito, o se volverán orgullosos. Selah
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no dejes que la gente malvada consiga lo que quiere. No dejes que sus planes funcionen, o se volverán orgullosos. Selah

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng ban cho kẻ ác điều nó ước muốn; xin đừng cho mưu kế nó thành công, [kẻo] chúng tự tôn mình lên. Sê-la
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng cho kẻ ác được điều chúng thèm khát; xin đừng để mưu kế chúng thành công, kẻo chúng sinh lòng kiêu ngạo. Sê-la
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng để những kẻ gian ác được điều chúng muốn. Xin đừng để kế hoạch của chúng thành công, kẻo chúng trở nên kiêu ngạo. Sê-la

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 악인의 소원을 들어주지 마시고, 그의 꾀를 이루지 마십시오. [그러면] 그들이 높아질 것입니다. 셀라
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 악인들이 바라는 것을 주지 마시고, 그들의 꾀가 이루어지지 않게 하십시오. 그러지 않으시면 그들이 교만해질 것입니다. 셀라
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 악한 사람들이 원하는 것을 얻지 못하게 해 주십시오. 그들의 계획이 이루어지지 않게 해 주십시오. 그렇지 않으면 그들이 교만해질 것입니다. 셀라

decisions.choice: they will be exalted: they would grow proud
alternatives: they rise up (joined with verse 10: "those around me raise their head")
decisions.reason: The last word (yarumu) is short and hard to place. It can be the result of their success ("or they will be exalted"), or it can begin the next line, "they lift up the head, those who surround me".

decisions.choice: his plan: a wicked scheme
decisions.reason: The word (zemam) is a plan, here an evil plot, as the verb in 37:12.

decisions.choice: the wicked ... they
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes "the wicked" as one person ("he", "his") who stands for all who act this way. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, which is how "the wicked" is heard in English and includes men and women alike; Literal keeps the Hebrew singular.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

records.literal_gloss: [The] head of those surrounding me — [the] trouble of their lips, may it cover them.

en.L: [As for the] head of those who surround me, may the trouble of their lips cover them.
en.B: As for those who close in around me, may the harm their own lips speak come down over their heads.
en.R: My enemies are all around me. Let the evil they say about others fall back on them.

fr.L: [Quant à la] tête de ceux qui m’entourent, que le mal de leurs lèvres les recouvre !
fr.B: Quant à ceux qui se resserrent autour de moi, que le mal que disent leurs lèvres retombe sur leur tête !
fr.R: Mes ennemis sont tout autour de moi. Que le mal qu’ils disent des autres retombe sur eux !

sw.L: [Kwa habari ya] kichwa cha wale wanaonizunguka, shida ya midomo yao na iwafunike.
sw.B: Kwa wale wanaonizingira, madhara yanayosemwa na midomo yao wenyewe na yawarudie juu ya vichwa vyao.
sw.R: Adui zangu wamenizunguka pande zote. Mabaya wanayoyasema kuhusu wengine na yawarudie wao wenyewe.

es.L: [En cuanto a la] cabeza de los que me rodean, que el mal de sus labios los cubra.
es.B: En cuanto a los que me cercan, que el daño que dicen sus propios labios les caiga sobre la cabeza.
es.R: Mis enemigos me rodean por todas partes. Que el mal que dicen de los demás se vuelva contra ellos.

vi.L: [Còn] đầu của những kẻ vây quanh tôi, nguyện điều tai hại từ môi chúng phủ lấp chúng.
vi.B: Còn những kẻ vây bủa tôi, nguyện điều tai hại do chính môi chúng nói ra đổ xuống trên đầu chúng.
vi.R: Kẻ thù vây quanh tôi. Nguyện những điều ác chúng nói về người khác quay lại đổ trên chính chúng.

ko.L: 저를 둘러싼 자들의 머리는, 그들 입술의 재앙이 그들을 덮기를 [바랍니다].
ko.B: 저를 에워싼 자들은, 그들의 입술이 말한 해악이 그들의 머리 위로 덮치게 하십시오.
ko.R: 제 원수들이 저를 둘러싸고 있습니다. 그들이 남에 대해 한 악한 말이 그들에게 되돌아가게 하십시오.

decisions.choice: may it cover them: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes this word in one form and its notes say to read it in another. The words follow the form to be read.

decisions.choice: the trouble of their lips: the harm they speak
alternatives: their leader's head (the head as the chief)
decisions.reason: The harm they plan with words (verse 4) is to come down on their own heads, as in 7:17. "Head" may be the head of each enemy or the chief among them.

decisions.choice: My enemies are all around me.
alternatives: As for the head of those around me
decisions.reason: Readable makes a short sentence of the opening phrase and names who is meant.

source.text: יִמּ֥וֹטוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם גֶּֽחָ֫לִ֥ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יַפִּלֵ֑ם בְּ֝מַהֲמֹר֗וֹת בַּֽל־יָקֽוּמוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: May they drop on them, burning coals; into the fire may he make them fall, into pits, [that] not they rise.

en.L: May burning coals drop upon them; into the fire may [one] cast them, into deep pits, [so that] they do not rise.
en.B: Let burning coals rain down on them; may they be hurled into fire, into deep pits, never to get up again.
en.R: May red-hot coals land on them. May they be pitched into fire, into deep holes they can never climb out of.

fr.L: Que des braises ardentes tombent sur eux ; dans le feu, qu’on les fasse tomber, dans des fosses profondes, [pour] qu’ils ne se relèvent pas !
fr.B: Que des braises ardentes pleuvent sur eux ; qu’ils soient jetés dans le feu, dans des fosses profondes, et qu’ils ne se relèvent jamais !
fr.R: Que des braises brûlantes tombent sur eux ! Qu’ils soient jetés dans le feu, dans des trous profonds dont ils ne pourront jamais sortir !

sw.L: Makaa ya moto na yawaangukie; motoni na [mtu] awatupe, katika mashimo marefu, [ili] wasiinuke.
sw.B: Makaa ya moto na yanyeshe juu yao; na watupwe motoni, katika mashimo marefu, wasiinuke tena kamwe.
sw.R: Makaa ya moto na yawaangukie. Na watupwe motoni, katika mashimo marefu wasiyoweza kutoka kamwe.

es.L: Que caigan sobre ellos brasas ardientes; que [alguien] los arroje al fuego, a fosas profundas, [para que] no se levanten.
es.B: Que lluevan sobre ellos brasas encendidas; que sean arrojados al fuego, a fosas profundas, para nunca más levantarse.
es.R: Que les caigan encima brasas al rojo vivo. Que los echen al fuego, a hoyos profundos de los que nunca puedan salir.

vi.L: Nguyện than đỏ rơi trên chúng; nguyện [có người] ném chúng vào lửa, vào những hố sâu, [để] chúng không dậy nổi.
vi.B: Nguyện than lửa đổ xuống như mưa trên chúng; nguyện chúng bị ném vào lửa, vào những hố sâu, không bao giờ trỗi dậy được nữa.
vi.R: Nguyện than nóng đỏ rơi xuống trên chúng. Nguyện chúng bị quăng vào lửa, vào những hố sâu mà chúng không bao giờ leo ra được.

ko.L: 타는 숯불이 그들 위에 떨어지기를, 그들이 불 속에, 깊은 구덩이에 던져져서 일어나지 못하기를 [바랍니다].
ko.B: 타는 숯불이 그들 위에 쏟아지게 하시고, 그들이 불 속에, 깊은 구덩이에 내던져져 다시는 일어나지 못하게 하십시오.
ko.R: 시뻘건 숯불이 그들 위에 떨어지기를 바랍니다. 그들이 불 속에, 기어 나올 수 없는 깊은 구덩이 속에 던져지기를 바랍니다.

decisions.choice: may they drop: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes this word in one form and its notes say to read it in another. The words follow the form to be read.

decisions.choice: burning coals and fire: judgment from heaven
decisions.reason: Coals and fire fall on the wicked in 11:6 and 18:13-14, recalling the fire that fell on Sodom (Genesis 19:24).

decisions.choice: pits: deep pits, perhaps watery ones
decisions.reason: The word (mahamorot) is found only here. It is some deep place from which no one comes up, like the pit of the dead.

decisions.choice: a prayer for judgment on the violent
decisions.reason: As in 5:11, the psalmist does not take revenge himself. He asks God to bring the harm these people plan back on them, and leaves the judgment to God.

decisions.choice: may they be hurled (B); may they be pitched (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "may he cast them" names no one; Balanced and Readable use the passive so that no subject is supplied, as Literal does with "[one]".

source.text: אִ֥ישׁ לָשׁוֹן֮ בַּל־יִכּ֪וֹן בָּ֫אָ֥רֶץ אִישׁ־חָמָ֥ס רָ֑ע יְ֝צוּדֶ֗נּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: A man of tongue not let him be established in the land; a man of violence — evil let it hunt him to blows.

en.L: {{gender:A person|A man}} of tongue — let {{gender:them|him}} not be established in the land; {{gender:a person|a man}} of violence — let evil hunt {{gender:them|him}} down with blow upon blow.
en.B: Let no slanderer find a firm place in the land; let disaster hunt down the violent and strike them again and again.
en.R: Do not let people who tell lies about others last in the land. Let trouble chase violent people and knock them down.

fr.L: {{gender:L’être|L’homme}} de langue — qu’il ne soit pas affermi dans le pays ; {{gender:l’être|l’homme}} de violence — que le mal le traque à coups redoublés !
fr.B: Qu’aucun calomniateur ne trouve de place sûre dans le pays ; que le malheur traque les violents et les frappe encore et encore !
fr.R: Ne laisse pas durer dans le pays les gens qui disent des mensonges sur les autres. Que le malheur poursuive les gens violents et les renverse !

sw.L: Mtu wa ulimi — asiimarishwe katika nchi; mtu wa jeuri — uovu na umwinde kwa pigo juu ya pigo.
sw.B: Msingiziaji yeyote asipate mahali imara katika nchi; maafa na yawawinde watu wa jeuri na kuwapiga tena na tena.
sw.R: Usiwaache watu wanaosema uongo juu ya wengine wadumu katika nchi. Shida na ziwakimbize watu wa jeuri na kuwaangusha.

es.L: {{gender:La persona|El hombre}} de lengua, que no se afiance en la tierra; {{gender:la persona|el hombre}} de violencia, que el mal le dé caza golpe tras golpe.
es.B: Que ningún calumniador encuentre lugar firme en la tierra; que la desgracia persiga a los violentos y los golpee una y otra vez.
es.R: No dejes que la gente que dice mentiras de los demás permanezca en la tierra. Que los problemas persigan a la gente violenta y la derriben.

vi.L: Kẻ có lưỡi [vu khống], nguyện nó không được đứng vững trong xứ; kẻ hung bạo, nguyện tai họa săn đuổi nó với hết đòn này đến đòn khác.
vi.B: Nguyện kẻ vu khống không tìm được chỗ đứng trong xứ; nguyện tai họa săn đuổi kẻ hung bạo và đánh gục chúng hết lần này đến lần khác.
vi.R: Xin đừng để những kẻ nói dối về người khác được tồn tại trong xứ. Nguyện tai họa đuổi theo những kẻ hung bạo và quật ngã chúng.

ko.L: 혀의 사람은 땅에서 굳게 서지 못하기를. 폭력의 사람은 재앙이 그를 쫓아 거듭 치기를.
ko.B: 남을 헐뜯는 자가 땅에 발붙이지 못하게 하시고, 재앙이 난폭한 자를 쫓아가서 거듭거듭 치게 하십시오.
ko.R: 남에 대해 거짓말하는 사람들이 땅에서 오래가지 못하게 하십시오. 재앙이 난폭한 사람들을 쫓아가 쓰러뜨리게 하십시오.

decisions.choice: a man of tongue: a slanderer
decisions.reason: A "man of tongue" is one who does harm with what he says, the slanderer of 101:5.

decisions.choice: blows: thrust after thrust, until they fall
decisions.reason: The word (madchefot) is found only here; it comes from a verb "to push, drive". Evil is pictured as a hunter that drives them on until they fall.

decisions.choice: be established: last, stand firm
decisions.reason: The verb (kun) is used of what is set firm and lasts (89:38; 101:7).

decisions.choice: the slanderer ... the violent ... them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable speak of the kind of person meant, in the plural where needed; Literal keeps the singular with a gender setting.

decisions.choice: "mtu" with no gender setting
decisions.reason: Swahili "mtu" means a person of either sex, and the verb prefix "a-" means he or she, so the sentence already says what the English inclusive option says.

decisions.choice: "kẻ có lưỡi [vu khống]" at Literal
decisions.reason: "A man of tongue" means a slanderer (see the meaning decision); in Vietnamese "kẻ có lưỡi" alone means nothing, so Literal brackets the word that says what kind of tongue.

source.text: יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְ֭הוָה דִּ֣ין עָנִ֑י מִ֝שְׁפַּ֗ט אֶבְיֹנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: I know that YHWH will do [the] cause of [the] poor, [the] justice of [the] needy.

en.L: I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will uphold [the] cause of [the] poor, [and] justice for [the] needy.
en.B: I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will take up the case of the oppressed and see that the needy get justice.
en.R: I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will defend poor people and make sure that people in need are treated fairly.

fr.L: Je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera [droit à] la cause du pauvre, [et] justice à l’indigent.
fr.B: Je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra en main la cause des opprimés et fera justice aux indigents.
fr.R: Je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} défendra les pauvres et veillera à ce que les gens dans le besoin soient traités avec justice.

sw.L: Ninajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatetea haki ya maskini, [na] hukumu ya haki kwa wahitaji.
sw.B: Ninajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataishughulikia kesi ya wanaoonewa na kuhakikisha kwamba wahitaji wanapata haki.
sw.R: Ninajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatetea maskini na kuhakikisha kwamba watu wenye shida wanatendewa haki.

es.L: Yo sé que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} defenderá [la] causa [del] afligido, [y la] justicia [de los] necesitados.
es.B: Yo sé que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} defenderá el caso de los oprimidos y hará que los necesitados reciban justicia.
es.R: Yo sé que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} defenderá a los pobres y se asegurará de que a los necesitados los traten con justicia.

vi.L: Tôi biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bênh vực duyên cớ của người khốn khổ, [và] lẽ công bằng cho người thiếu thốn.
vi.B: Tôi biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đứng ra bênh vực người bị áp bức, và đem lại công lý cho người thiếu thốn.
vi.R: Tôi biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bênh vực người nghèo khổ và lo cho những người túng thiếu được đối xử công bằng.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 가난한 자의 송사를 이루시고 궁핍한 자들에게 공의를 [베푸실] 것을 제가 압니다.
ko.B: 저는 압니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 억눌린 사람의 송사를 맡아 주시고, 궁핍한 사람들이 정의를 얻게 하실 것을.
ko.R: 저는 압니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 가난한 사람들의 편을 들어 주시고, 어려운 사람들이 공정한 대우를 받게 하실 것입니다.

decisions.choice: I know: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes this word in one form and its notes say to read it in another. The words follow the form to be read.

decisions.choice: the cause of the poor: their case before a judge
decisions.reason: The word (din) is a legal case. The LORD acts as judge and as advocate for the poor ('ani), the afflicted who have no one else to speak for them (9:5; 10:18).

decisions.choice: the needy: the poor who must depend on others
decisions.reason: The word ('evyon) is often paired with "poor" (40:18; 109:22). The psalmist counts himself among them.

source.text: אַ֣ךְ צַ֭דִּיקִים יוֹד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶ֑ךָ יֵשְׁב֥וּ יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely [the] righteous will give thanks to your name; [the] upright will dwell with your face.

en.L: Surely [the] righteous will give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name; [the] upright will dwell in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence.
en.B: The righteous will surely give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and people of integrity will make their home before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: People who do what is right will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for who {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. Honest people will live close to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Oui, [les] justes rendront grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ; [ceux qui sont] droits habiteront devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face.
fr.B: Oui, les justes rendront grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, et les gens intègres demeureront devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Les gens qui font ce qui est bien {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercieront pour ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es. Les gens honnêtes vivront près de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Hakika wenye haki watalishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; wanyofu watakaa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Wenye haki hakika watalishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, na watu waadilifu watafanya makao yao mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu wanaotenda haki watakushukuru kwa jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyo. Watu wanyofu wataishi karibu {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}.

es.L: Ciertamente [los] justos darán gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre; [los] rectos habitarán en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia.
es.B: Los justos sin duda darán gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, y la gente íntegra vivirá delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: La gente que hace lo correcto {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dará gracias por lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres. La gente honrada vivirá cerca de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Chắc chắn [những người] công chính sẽ cảm tạ danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; [những người] ngay thẳng sẽ ở trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chắc chắn những người công chính sẽ cảm tạ danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và những người ngay thẳng sẽ được sống trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Những người làm điều đúng sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì bản tính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Những người ngay thật sẽ được sống gần bên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 참으로 의인들이 주님의 이름에 감사드리고, 정직한 자들이 주님 앞에 살 것입니다.
ko.B: 의인들은 반드시 주님의 이름에 감사드리고, 정직한 사람들은 주님 앞에서 살 것입니다.
ko.R: 바르게 사는 사람들이 주님께서 어떤 분이신지 알고 감사드릴 것입니다. 정직한 사람들이 주님 가까이에서 살 것입니다.

decisions.choice: your name: God himself, as he has shown himself
decisions.reason: The name stands for God as he is known by what he has done (5:12; 54:8).

decisions.choice: dwell with your face: live in God's presence
decisions.reason: To live before God's face is to be near him and in his favor, as guests in his house (11:7; 15:1; 23:6).

decisions.choice: for who you are
decisions.reason: Readable says what the name stands for (m1).

decisions.choice: people who do what is right; honest people
decisions.reason: As in 1:5 (tsaddiq); the upright (yashar) are those who are straight and honest.
